reason: I might forward a few receipts to try it since it's free, but I'm not paying a bot I've never heard of or adding it to my work groups. I only dig into the receipts when something feels off, so this isn't urgent enough for me to trust a stranger with it.
objection: Who's behind this? An unknown bot would sit in every work chat reading what my staff send, with access to my Google account, and it could disappear in six months. The sheet staying in my own Google is nice, but I'd still be rebuilding the habit for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: Another villa operator I know in Bali using it for a few months, telling me the totals match and it caught a duplicate, plus a real company name I can look up.
